question: Should gateway restart records land as this bounded `gateway_restart_audit` table, or be reworked to integrate with the merged metadata-only `audit_events` ledger?
rationale: Current main now has a generic audit ledger for agent/tool actions while this PR adds a restart-specific durable table with different columns, retention, and privacy semantics; automation cannot choose that product/security boundary.

options.title: Accept separate restart audit table
options.body: After rebase, merge this design if maintainers want restart-specific forensics with its own 512-row retention and redaction contract.

options.title: Fold into the generic audit ledger
options.body: Ask for a rework if restart records should share the `audit_events` query, retention, and public read surface rather than adding a second audit table.

options.title: Pause the PR
options.body: Close or pause if restart audit persistence should wait for a broader audit model decision instead of landing now.

recommendation.title: Accept separate restart audit table
recommendation.body: After rebase, merge this design if maintainers want restart-specific forensics with its own 512-row retention and redaction contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The current product decision intersects directly with the broad audit-ledger direction merged in PR #98704.
